Vj.bar_b_note: Ornate blue-and-gold shelled turtle reads clearly and outscales the ruler, but the gilded shell plates look more like a jewellery prop than grounded shell, and the neutral stage gives no Valheim-class light to carry it.

Us.bar_b_note: Vivid blue-violet finned serpent has a strong silhouette, but on land it reads as a fish lying on the floor, and its flat saturated material lacks the rim-lit surface detail of the owner bar.

Ow.bar_b_note: Near-black plated bear-boar is one dark mid-low value with no rim light, so it merges into the backdrop and turns into an unreadable rock-like ball in faint end.

Wf.bar_b_note: B's fluffy pale-blue fur gets close to the Tanglevolt bar, but A's smooth, flat-shaded body with a mesh that comes apart in faint end, and B's upright faint end, keep both short of a shipping finish.

Lg.bar_b_note: Glossy cobalt toad with a pale belly is appealing, clearly lit and big against the ruler, though faint mid and faint end barely differ from standing and the swim frame floats on a flat blue plane.

Sa.bar_b_note: Very dark navy lizard-hound has a good hit-react silhouette, but its low value and lack of rim light let it sink into the dark stage, and in faint end it coils into an illegible lump.

Db.bar_b_note: Muddy brown-green gloom with no purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta telegraph rings and a dense HUD that boxes in a small fight sink it well below the Palworld boss-fight frame.

Xx.bar_b_note: Spotted blue salamander-dragon with coral fins is readable and on-palette, but it goes plank-flat in faint end with the ruler overlapping the tail, and the plain stage carries no atmosphere.

Tj.bar_b_note: Electric-blue noisy coat on a badger-mole body is high-saturation but reads as a busy texture rather than real fur, and the creature hides the ruler in standing and faint end.

Ph.bar_b_note: Same striking blue finned serpent as Us, plus a ridden frame where the rider is a near-invisible speck on its back; good silhouette, but the material and grounding fall short of the owner bar.

Uw.bar_b_note: Black dog with yellow and blue glyph markings has a clean standing silhouette, but its near-black material has no fur read, and in faint mid and faint end it smears into a flat streak.

Lq.bar_b_note: Green-and-gold spined lizard is long and readable side-on, but it is low contrast against the stage and its faint end goes stick-flat with the ruler overlapping the tail.

Uy.bar_b_note: Warm grandfatherly villager with clear eyes, a mossy vest and an earthy palette that fits the key art; his softer animated-film face is more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures but stays appealing.

Ry.bar_b_note: A's larger, fully wrapped recipe text and icon-led Craft and Leave hints read well, but neither side has the teal interaction or gold progression accents, and B's truncated tiny text and grey 'Craft: A / Enter' footnote would fail on a 7-inch screen.

Zo.bar_b_note: Naturalistic stag with moss mantle and antlers is the closest to the owner bar here: clear silhouette, believable anatomy, poses that read grounded, and a plausible ridden scale.

top_changes.change: Add a creature rim and key light, plus value lift, to the dark-material creatures (Ow, Sa, Uw, Lq) and rework their albedo so fur, plate and scale detail separates from the ground, as Stormursa and Tanglevolt do in the owner bar.

Stormwood fight: keep the camera clear of trunks and canopy, add the purple storm sky, white-violet lightning and rim light on both fighters, swap flat magenta telegraph rings for real-object effects, and slim the HUD so the fight fills the frame.
Fix the faint-end poses that flatten or break the mesh (Wf A, Uw, Xx, Lq) and the ones that stay upright (Wf B, Lg) so the faint reads grounded without a label.
